title: Selling and Promotion - Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA - Selling: Company Selling Policies
subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Why do companies establish selling policies?
options: To ensure consistency, protect profitability, and comply with legal/ethical standards.
To make it as difficult as possible for a customer to make a purchase.
To discourage sales representatives from earning commissions.
To ensure all competitors use the same prices.
questions.explain: Selling policies guide sales operations to ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant interactions that protect both the customer and the company's bottom line.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: A policy that dictates what percentage off a customer receives if they purchase more than 100 units is known as a:
questions.explain: Pricing policies, such as volume discounts or wholesale pricing rules, dictate how price reductions can be applied to large orders.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: If a salesperson is assigned to exclusively sell to clients within the state of Texas, what kind of selling policy is being enforced?
questions.explain: Sales territory policies divide markets geographically or by industry to prevent salespeople from competing against each other within the same company.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Which of the following would be considered an unethical violation of company selling policies?
options: Suggesting a related item to a customer at checkout.
Promising a customer a delivery date that the salesperson knows the company cannot meet, just to secure the sale.
Offering a standard seasonal discount to a loyal client.
Providing an honest demonstration of a product's limitations.
questions.explain: Lying about delivery capabilities is deceptive, violates ethical selling standards, and damages long-term trust.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Which type of company policy dictates the conditions under which a customer can bring a defective product back for a refund?
questions.explain: Return and exchange policies define the rules, timeframes, and conditions under which customers can return items.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: A salesperson reaches out to management to request authorization to match a competitor's price for a valuable client. This involves navigating the company's:
questions.explain: Pricing policies determine the boundaries of price negotiations, discounts, and competitor matching.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA
